title: Accounts Receivable Administrator
description:
Role: Accounts Receivable Administrator

Location: Hessle, HU13

Are you a proactive and driven Accounts Receivable Administrator with great communication skills? Can you manage and support company credit control by taking responsibility for your own book of debtor accounts?

Then Scientific Laboratory Supplies (SLS) is the right fit for you. Join us and contribute to our mission of being the UK's largest independent supplier of laboratory equipment, chemicals, and consumables.

We have an exciting opportunity available for a Credit Controller to join our finance team based in Hessle, HU13, on a full-time, permanent basis.

Job Summary:

The Accounts Receivable Administrator will join the SLS Finance team and contribute to all areas within the finance function. The successful candidate will be asked to support the busy credit control function in the office but must be willing to provide support as needed to other areas of the finance function which will include communicating with colleagues, external parties, customers, and vendors.

Key Responsibilities:
- Take a proactive role in managing and supporting company credit control by taking responsibility for own book of debtor accounts.
- Use all forms of communication (email, letters, and telephone) to professionally contact debtors and ensure payment of outstanding invoices.
- Support the ongoing process of credit checking new customers and open new credit accounts ensuring the company has all the relevant information.
- Support and resolve all problems experienced in the credit control function including providing copy invoices, obtaining proof of delivery.
- Work closely with colleagues in Sales and Customer Services to resolve any customer queries and enquiries to progress matters to a satisfactory conclusion.
- Report regularly to the Accounts Office Manager on outstanding issues and promptly inform them of potential debtors' problems.
- When required, help colleagues to manage the "slsledger" email inbox, resolving enquiries quickly and effectively and to pass enquiries onto colleagues in both Finance and other departments for resolution.
- Maintain financial system records and enter data accurately.

Perform general clerical duties when required, including, but not limited to, typing, mailing, filing correspondence and answering telephone calls.

Ideal Candidate:
- Prior experience of working in a credit control / accounts receivable function.
- Comfortable with IT.
- Strong literacy and numeracy skills.
- Interpersonal skills, appreciation of good internal and external customer service behaviour.
- Be organised, methodical, self-motivated, and driven.
- Responsive and re-active.
- Good customer-facing and personal relationship skills.
- Be able to communicate at all levels.
- Ability to work within a flexible team.

About us:

SLS are the UK's largest independent supplier of laboratory equipment, chemicals, and consumables. Because of our independence, we have a unique approach to sourcing and supplying the highest quality, best value products, and brands. Supplying to a wide range of sectors, provides a diverse and interesting customer base as well as providing countless opportunity to grow and expand.

With customers all over the UK, we are a stable and growing company who have an excellent reputation in the market.

We are passionate about our people and have developed a strong team dynamic who are welcoming and supportive of new individuals, joining the company with a brilliant management team to support you as you find your feet in the role.

We are also proud to be a Living Wage Employer and committed to equal opportunities and actively promote a diverse and inclusive working environment, and fairness for everyone.

Alongside our commitment to your professional and personal development, we also offer a generous benefits package including:
- Competitive salary
- 25 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays
- Company pension
- Enhanced Maternity and Paternity leave
- Small, friendly, and sociable teams with staff events
- Company profit bonus schemes
- Cycle 2work schemes
- Career opportunities for development and progression

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
An established and successful firm of Chartered Accountants is looking to strengthen its Payroll Bureau team in their Goole office.

It's a full time, Monday to Friday role, dealing with:
- Processing payrolls, gross to net
- Processing HMRC submissions
- Calculation of statutory payments
- Liaising directly with clients
- Resolving queries and general support
- Working towards tight deadlines
- Sending BACS transmissions
- Preparation of P45s and P60s

The successful applicant will need a minimum of a year's previous experience in Payroll (ideally bureau) and knowledge of associated tasks, have an understanding of Auto Enrolment with good numeracy and a team player.

On offer is a competitive salary, contributory Pension and life insurance scheme, flexible working including Flexitime system, annual leave of 25 days, plus bank holidays (full time equivalent), convenient office location with easily accessible free car parking, Employee Assistance Programme, friendly working environment

title: Accounts Administrator
description:

The Role

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
As an Accounts Assistant in Hull, you will help keep the accounting and finance function organised by completing day-to-day finance tasks accurately. Your work will support clear financial records for an organisation in the industrial / manufacturing sector.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the industrial / manufacturing sector in Hull.

Description
- Process day-to-day finance transactions accurately to maintain clear and up-to-date records.
- Enter financial data into internal systems and check information is complete before it is recorded.
- Maintain organised finance files and documents so information is easy to find when needed.
- Review transaction details and resolve basic data queries to reduce errors in financial records.
- Prepare routine finance information for the Accounting & Finance department.
- Work with colleagues to gather documents and information needed for day-to-day finance tasks.
- Keep records accurate and follow agreed internal finance procedures.

Profile

A successful 'Accounts Assistant' should have:
- Experience completing routine finance administration and transaction processing.
- Confidence entering and checking financial data with a high level of accuracy.
- The ability to keep finance documents and records well organised.
- Experience working with finance systems or spreadsheets to maintain clear information.
- The ability to investigate straightforward data queries and correct errors.
- A practical approach to managing day-to-day accounting and finance tasks.

Job Offer
- Temporary, interim Accounts Assistant assignment.
- Location: Hull.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
About the Role

HW Finance are recruiting for a well regarded business in Hull to hire a Finance Assistant.

You will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, processing transactions, reconciling accounts and supporting timely financial reporting, helping to ensure the smooth and efficient running of the finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Process invoices, payments and receipts accurately and efficiently.
- Carry out regular account reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
- Support accounts payable and receivable, including supplier payments and outstanding customer balances.
- Post client receipts, process direct debits, respond to client queries and produce consolidated invoices.
- Maintain accurate financial records in line with company policies and regulatory requirements.
- Assist with financial reporting, including aged payables, and support audit requirements.
- Manage finance correspondence and shared inboxes, providing general administrative support.
- Work collaboratively with the finance team and uphold the company's core values.

Skills and Experience
- Previous experience in a similar finance role, such as Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant or Finance Administrator.
- Experience processing invoices, payments and account reconciliations.
- Good numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Proficiency in Excel.
- Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent communication skills and a customer-focused approach.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

This role is based full time on site initially and offers a salary of £25-30k depending on experience + a competitive benefits package and free parking.

If you'd like to know more, please click the link to apply!

title: Sales Ledger Clerk
description:
A company who are the largest UK supplier of its products is seeking a Sales Ledger Clerk to join their team. Applicants will be suitably experienced with all aspects of Accounts Receivable as well as Credit Control and related admin. A high degree of accuracy, a proactive work ethic and the ability to manage your workload to changing deadlines are fundamental qualities this client requires.
The Role:
Permanent, full time hours, office based.
Manage all aspects of sales ledger and assist the credit control team.
Credit check new clients and monitor payment history.
Raise invoices (Including duplicates) and verify receipt.
Identify, investigate and solve all account related queries.
Ensure all company financial admin is accurately processed.
The Candidate:
You must possess experience with sales ledger, reconciliations and credit control.
Confidence and accuracy when managing accounts to changing deadlines.
Be assertive and a strong communicator when liaising with suppliers and colleagues to solve account queries.
Ability to make decisions and foresee potential issues by utilising common sense.
Possess a high levels of IT literacy and work ethics.
The Benefits:
Above average holidays
Company bonus scheme
Progression
